title: Komets win fourth in a row with 3-1 victory at Norfolk - NewsBreak
text:
By Glenn Marini ,
1 hours ago
NORFOLK, Va. (WANE) ‚Äì The Komets are now alone in first place in the ECHL‚Äôs Central Division standings following a 3-1 win at Norfolk on Wednesday night.
Coming into the night the Komets were tied with Toledo, both with 61 points on the season. With the victory ‚Äì Fort Wayne‚Äôs fourth-straight ‚Äì the Komets now hold a two-point lead over the Walleye.
Kyrill Tyutyayev opened the scoring in the first period with his 14th goal of the season. With the game knotted at 1-all in the second period Jayden Grubbe scored off an odd bounce of the puck for his fifth goal of the season, giving the Komets a 2-1 lead.
James Stefan would add an empty net goal with 41 seconds left in regulation ‚Äì Stefan‚Äôs 19th goal of the season ‚Äì to set the final at 3-1.
Samuel Jonsson stopped 25-of-26 shots in goal for the Komets.
The Komets and Admirals play again on Friday and Saturday, with both games set to start at 7:05 pm.
